scope: Finite intersection gate for selected padding triangles against actual active mail/plate triangles, evaluated after skinning and morphs. Exported skin weights and bind-space radial/axial normals select garment walls; hems, steep folds, ambiguous anatomy and unmatched patches remain unassessed. Pairing and source patches are fixed from undeformed POSITION and inverse-bind joints independently of the measured gap. Signed tracked gaps are diagnostics: negative values without an actual intersection are inconclusive for layer ordering because patches can slide or fold. Thumb tests establish nearest surface reach only. This is not whole-body collision freedom, all-surface clearance, continuous collision detection, cloth simulation, thumb opposition, penetration volume, dynamic stability or a full animation sweep. Hidden torso skin is absent in this model and is not assessed. Padding the build hides under mail or plate is excluded from that layer's gate and is instead required to lie under it in bind space.

selectionDomains.scope: Wall/region classification is independent of signed clearance. Excluded faces and unmatched attempts carry no separation conclusion.
